sam: quick q — for the softfail/handshake flow, should operators explicitly ACK fallback handoffs or is viewing enough?
anna: explicit ACK. we need an auditable decision (who/when/why). viewing is too fuzzy. :eyes:
sam: ok. UX: ACK with optional TTL or manual-only?
kai: short TTL (5m) default so things move if operator is OOTO. banner: 'auto-apply in 5m unless rejected'.
lucy: configurable per-rollout. some customers will require manual-only.
sam: plan: configurable default, inline TTL dropdown when ACKing (5m/15m/1h/manual). record decision_id in history.
anna: event model: decision_id, actor, action(accept|reject|simulate), reason, ttl_seconds, applied_at, originating_node. simple JSON to persist.
sam: sample API: POST /api/rollouts/{id}/handshake Body {decision_id, action, reason, ttl} -> 200 queued with decision_id.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: recorded rollout.handshake.request (id=uuid-1234) at 1751112223 - status: pending
lucy: add 'simulate' mode: runs against sandbox for 1 request, records sample and doesn't consume customer quota. mark telemetry simulated=true.
kai: backend: on accept && ttl>0 schedule background apply job; support revoke which cancels job and logs revoked event.
anna: UI: show countdown timer, revoke button, compact diff of before/after model variant + est latency/cost delta, toggle details.
sam: concurrency: protect with CAS on rollout revision, return 409 with current decision list and allow merge/override with extra confirmation.
lucy: audit: export decision JSON/CSV, but redact customer prompts unless allowed. include operator initials + role in audit view.
ops-bot: rule added: on action==reject post to #eng-oncall with decision_id and link to sample.
anna: next steps: PM acceptance criteria, design mock, backend handshake API + persistence, ops-bot hook.
sam: I'll draft ADR for schema and schedule 30m sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder: meeting scheduled by sam at 1751190000 for 30 minutes
